I only ran checks this hour and changed nothing. The main new finding is that 3 friction-batch runs failed even though the batch log shows them as finished cleanly.

**What's running:**
- **Friction batch (fric5):** 39 runs (one per case and motion) have finished since 12:27, 13 of them in the last hour. 5 are running on GPUs 3 and 4 and about 37 are waiting, so it should finish around 18:00.
- **relE p068 run 2:** it is at t=2.139 and moving only 0.029 per hour because the time step is stuck at its minimum. At that rate it needs about 30 more hours to reach t=3.
- **Health:** all 6 FEBio logs are growing. All services are up; the sessions that are down are jobs that already finished and left their done marker.

**Resources:** CPU is the limit: 31 of the 32 cores are taken and 24.6 are actually in use. Memory is 70.9 of 137.4 GB with no out-of-memory kills. GPUs 0, 1, 2, 5 and 6 belong to other users. The FEBio queue is empty and has had no work since 11-07 01:36; the task queue is also empty.

**New problem:** the flexion runs for p002, p036 and p081 ended with an FEBio error, but the batch log records them as finished with no error. None has a done marker, so this batch won't run them again. I've asked the science side to decide whether to rerun them or accept them.

**Requests in the status file, still open:**
- Whether to keep relE p068 run 2 going for about 30 more hours.
- Next work for GPUs 3 and 4 and about 25 cores, which free up when the friction batch ends around 18:00.
- What to do with the 5 failed gate2 tasks.
